prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for 7 kinds of change with only 1 test; rules are stated only when at least 2 tests agree.
'home, wait_info' and 'finish, new_screen' are helpful, supported by multiple winning tests (3 of 7 and 2 of 5 won, respectively).
'adoption, redesign' and 'sign_in, redesign' consistently hurt performance across tests.
No clear effect was seen for 'adoption, layout', 'adoption, notification', 'choose_path, layout', 'sign_in, hint', and 'sign_in, incentive', as all tests yielded no clear effect.
Results for 'choose_path, copy' and 'choose_path, hint' remain inconsistent across tests.
Predictions were often overly optimistic for unhelpful changes and underpredicted gains on unexpected winning tests.

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen System Audio Preview: Displays an ambient sound toggle and loading info badge on the waiting screen to engage users while waiting. (why: Home waiting step has a long mean duration (2336s) and high drop-off. Lessons show 'home, wait_info' is supported by multiple winning tests.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Interaction Launcher Screen: Adds a dedicated post-onboarding launch checklist screen showing how to summon and minimize your pet. (why: Support mails highlight confusion around controlling and hiding pets. Lessons show 'finish, new_screen' is helpful.)
2: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desktop Status Banner: Adds a live step-by-step desktop environment loading checklist on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting screen has a high mean time of 2336s. 'home, wait_info' is proven effective in prior tests.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Adoption Pledge New Flow Step: Adds a pre-adoption pledge screen before photo upload where users select their pet's primary behavior trait. (why: Adoption step drops conversion down to 60.9%. Adding a quick emotional commitment flow increases user investment.)
4: [choose_path, redesign] Interactive Story Screen Redesign: Redesigns the app intro story screen with a dynamic mascot preview component. (why: Initial path choice stage takes a mean 514s; a focused spotlight story layout engages users right away.)
5: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Readiness Notification Switch: Adds a system alert toggle component on the waiting screen notifying users when pet rendering finishes. (why: Waiting screen has high mean time (2336s). Providing a readiness notification keeps users informed if they tab away.)
6: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Visibility Quick Guide Flow: Adds an interactive desktop pet visibility screen explaining how to toggle pet overlay on/off. (why: Multiple support emails asked how to hide or show their pet on desktop. 'finish, new_screen/new_flow' is effective.)
7: [choose_path, hint] App Intro Path Discovery Hint: Adds a subtle hint banner on the intro story screen reassuring users that pet selection can be changed later. (why: Users take a long mean time (514s) on choose_path, likely due to decision paralysis.)

scores.note: home, wait_info is a proven winning pattern (+2.1% average lift), though low step drop-off caps total impact.

Proven positive change type (+2.1% lift), addresses long duration on home screen.
Targeting largest drop-off step (adoption), but adding flow steps adds friction and tends to fail.
Targeting choose_path duration, but screen redesigns consistently hurt performance (-1.7%).
Notification toggles have shown negative lift (-2.0%) in previous tests.
